secondary_sources: NPFMC — Pacific Coast Groundfish & Shellfish Observer Program
_provenance.notes: Dungeness crab (Metacarcinus magister) is Alaska's third-most valuable crab fishery after king and snow crab. Primary fishing areas include Southeast Alaska (Craig, Ketchikan, Sitka), Prince William Sound, Cook Inlet, and Kodiak. Unlike BSAI crab, Dungeness are managed by ADF&G under state regulations rather than NPFMC federal plan. They are highly sensitive to ocean acidification through pteropod dissolution affecting larval food web, and are increasingly used as a climate indicator species.
